items.title: What Could Chinese Import Curbs Mean For Lumentum Holdings (LITE)?
items.summary: Lumentum Holdings (NasdaqGS:LITE) is in focus as Washington drafts new limits on Chinese optical transceiver imports for data centers. The proposed U.S. rules target data center equipment sourced from Chinese vendors, including high speed optical modules used in AI and cloud networks. Domestic optical component suppliers could see increased demand as large U.S. data center operators reassess sourcing away from restricted Chinese imports.
